channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: The conversion clock is still Texas process, now with a named campus print. Tomorrow’s PUCT open meeting (11 Sep) takes up Project 58481 — the permanent ≥75 MW large-load interconnection rule — with staff’s 3 Sep recommended final order cutting post-reservation deposit forfeiture from 80% to 20% while keeping the $50k/MW security, and three 765 kV transmission items on the same agenda. Separately, IREN’s 8 Sep GlobeNewswire release put the 2 GW Sweetwater Hub (1,400 MW + 600 MW) into ERCOT Batch Zero as conditional Base Load — the first major named campus disclosure after ERCOT’s 3 Sep classifications notice. The Silicon Tape is another clean confirm morning: Lambda H100 $3.99 and B200 $6.69 unchanged across 56 re-read list prints; CoreWeave spot rows not visible in today’s static HTML.

item.title: Compute brief — 10 September 2026
item.description: The conversion clock is still Texas process, now with a named campus print. Tomorrow’s PUCT open meeting (11 Sep) takes up Project 58481 — the permanent ≥75 MW large-load interconnection rule — with staff’s 3 Sep recommended final order cutting post-reservation deposit forfeiture from 80% to 20% while keeping the $50k/MW security, and three 765 kV transmission items on the same agenda. Separately, IREN’s 8 Sep GlobeNewswire release put the 2 GW Sweetwater Hub (1,400 MW + 600 MW) into ERCOT Batch Zero as conditional Base Load — the first major named campus disclosure after ERCOT’s 3 Sep classifications notice. The Silicon Tape is another clean confirm morning: Lambda H100 $3.99 and B200 $6.69 unchanged across 56 re-read list prints; CoreWeave spot rows not visible in today’s static HTML. Countries: United States / Texas: PUCT Project 58481 permanent large-load rule on 11 Sep agenda (Item 24). Staff order: $50k/MW deposit; forfeiture 80%→20% after reservation; full refund pre-study; interconnection fee removed. United States / Texas: IREN Sweetwater 2 GW (1.4 GW + 0.6 GW) conditionally Base Load in ERCOT Batch Zero (8 Sep PR). 300 MW gross under construction at SW1; Q4 2027 target. Still conditional. United States / Texas: ERCOT M-A080326-04 (3 Sep) still the process print: conditional classifications to TSPs/DSPs; no public MW list. Verification/audit path continues. Malaysia: Firmus–OpenAI (8 Sep) still the live SEA print: two Malaysia AI Factory sites; >900 MW contracted portfolio-wide.
